title: Do a quick pre-ride check
summary: A five-minute walkaround of tires, lights, brakes, chain and fluids before you head out.

steps.text: Tires: look for damage and check pressure against your spec sheet. Do this before riding, while they're cold.
Lights: check the headlight high and low beam, tail light, brake light on both levers, and all four turn signals.
Brakes: squeeze each lever and press the pedal. They should feel firm and the bike shouldn't roll when pushed.
Chain or belt: on a chain bike, check slack and that it's lubed. On a scooter, listen for squeals on pull-off.
Fluids: check the oil level window or dipstick, and coolant level on liquid-cooled bikes. Look under the bike for drips.
Controls: the throttle should snap closed by itself, and the mirrors should be set before you move off.
steps.caution: A throttle that sticks open is dangerous. Don't ride until it is fixed.
